Routines

top source chromis::get_calib

CRISP pipeline

chromis::get_calib, states, no_fits=no_fits [, status=integer], darkstatus=darkstatus [, darkname=strarr] [, darkdata=array], flatstatus=flatstatus [, flatname=strarr] [, flatdata=array], gainstatus=gainstatus [, gainname=strarr] [, gaindata=array], pinhstatus=pinhstatus [, pinhname=strarr] [, pinhdata=array] [, polcname=strarr] [, polcdata=array] [, polsname=strarr] [, polsdata=array], sflatstatus=sflatstatus [, sflatname=strarr] [, sflatdata=array], cflatstatus=cflatstatus [, cflatname=strarr] [, cflatdata=array], cgainstatus=cgainstatus, cgainname=cgainname, cgaindata=cgaindata, sgainstatus=sgainstatus [, sgainname=strarr] [, sgaindata=array], clcgainstatus=clcgainstatus, clcgainname=clcgainname, clcgaindata=clcgaindata [, timestamp=string]

From state data, return file names for calibration data and the data itself.

Parameters

states in type=structarr

The states, the calibrations of which the keywords refer to.

Author information

Author:

Mats Löfdahl, ISP

History:

2016-05-26 : MGL. Initial version including darks, flats, and pinholes. Added support for summed flats.

2016-05-27 : MGL. Bugfixes.

2016-06-02 : MGL. Added gains.

2016-08-23 : THI. Rename camtag to detector and channel to camera, so the names match those of the corresponding SolarNet keywords.

2016-09-04 : THI. Wideband pinhole names without narrowband tuning info.

2018-04-18 : MGL. Rewrote using filenames() method. Removed keywords for returning file headers.

2018-07-11 : MGL. New keywords, individual status for the different kinds of data.

2018-07-25 : Sum darks and flats, and make gains as needed.

2025-03-28 : MGL. New keyword timestamp.

2025-05-28 : MGL. Adapt to polarimetric data.
